function.name: get_curated_pools
function.description: Retrieve high-quality, live curated DeFi yield pools from DeFi Garden matching criteria like token and chain. This query filters for safe, substantial pools with TVL >= $10M and APY <= 1000%.

token.description: Optional token symbol to filter results (e.g. 'USDC', 'ETH', 'USDT')

chain.description: Optional chain name to filter results (e.g. 'Ethereum', 'Arbitrum', 'Base', 'Solana')
